title: Grounding Corpus
description: Output schema for content-grounding.sh — a teaching corpus assembled from a prioritized source chain.

subject.description: The original human-readable subject string passed to content-grounding.sh.

built_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the corpus was built.

sources.description: Ordered list of source entries that make up the teaching corpus.

source_ref.description: A stable identifier for the source: URL, file path, KB document ID, palace memory ID, etc.

source_type.description: Category of the source, corresponding to the tier that produced it.

confidence.description: Retrieval confidence score in the range [0, 1].

is_misconception.description: True when this source documents a known-wrong belief about the subject.

content_summary.description: A brief summary of the source content (at least 10 characters).
